title: Monster eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <ellipse cx='46' cy='68' rx='26' ry='24' fill='#7ad14f'/>
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='68' rx='26' ry='24' fill='none' stroke='#a8e87a' stroke-width='2'/>

  <ellipse cx='46' cy='74' rx='15' ry='13' fill='#c8f59a'/>

  <polygon points='28,50 24,34 36,44' fill='#e86a3a'/>
  <polygon points='64,50 68,34 56,44' fill='#e86a3a'/>

  <ellipse cx='37' cy='58' rx='6' ry='7' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <circle cx='75' cy='55' r='1.6' fill='#5c2e0e'/>
  <circle cx='81' cy='56' r='1.6' fill='#5c2e0e'/>
  <circle cx='77' cy='61' r='1.6' fill='#5c2e0e'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='62' r='1.6' fill='#5c2e0e'/>
  <!-- crumbs -->
  <circle cx='72' cy='50' r='1.8' fill='#e8a95e'/>
  <circle cx='85' cy='49' r='1.8' fill='#e8a95e'/>

  <circle cx='70' cy='54' r='4' fill='#7ad14f'/>
